source_caption:
📺 Step by Step (1991–1998)

Step by Step follows Frank Lambert, a divorced contractor and father of three, and Carol Foster, a widowed beautician and mother of three, who unexpectedly fall in love and get married, bringing their two very different families together under one roof in Port Washington, Wisconsin. As their six children struggle to adjust to their new blended family, personality clashes, sibling rivalries, teenage romances, and hilarious misunderstandings create endless chaos. Frank’s laid-back parenting style often conflicts with Carol’s more organized approach, while their children learn to navigate complicated relationships and unexpected changes. From J.T.‘s mischievous behavior and Dana’s sharp intelligence to Cody’s unforgettable personality, the series delivers memorable comedy and heartwarming family moments. Starring Patrick Duffy, Suzanne Somers, Staci Keanan, Brandon Call, Angela Watson, and Christine Lakin, the show explores love, marriage, friendship, growing up, and the challenges of bringing two families together.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creators: William Bickley & Michael Warren

📺 Seasons: 7 • 160 Episodes

📚 Setting: Port Washington, Wisconsin

source_details.synopsis: Step by Step is an American television sitcom created by William Bickley and Michael Warren for ABC's TGIF Friday-night lineup. Set in Port Washington, Wisconsin, it follows single parents Frank Lambert and Carol Foster (Patrick Duffy and Suzanne Somers), each with three children, who marry and form a blended family in spite of their children's mutual resentment. It aired on ABC from September 20, 1991 to August 15, 1997, and then on CBS from September 19, 1997 to June 26, 1998, with a total of 160 half-hour episodes spanning seven seasons.
